verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe the Copilot cloud agent working independently in the background to complete tasks, running in fully isolated cloud sandboxes. Tasks can be assigned from issues, `@copilot` PR mentions, or automations, and monitored from a centralized session control page. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the cloud agent, and explicit documentation of how long tasks can run or other runtime limits.
